highlights: Annual safeguarding training for all staff
Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) and Whole School Pastoral Lead
Visitor registration and mandatory lanyard system with color-coding
Code of conduct for visitors on campus regarding privacy and interactions
safety.policy_summary: Si Ri Panya has a comprehensive safeguarding policy where all staff and board members read and agree annually to safeguard children. The school enforces strict visitor controls including office registration, mandatory lanyard wearing (Blue for staff, Yellow for external staff, Red for visitors), and clear rules against unauthorized photography or exchanging personal info with children.
